decisions.reason: The net price display plugin is cheap to maintain and fits the core B2B shop offer, so although it was not seen on the website in 2020 and 2021, it stays open until clearer evidence shows it has lost its value.
The ERP interface supports the firm's multichannel strategy and still holds integration value at low upkeep cost, so the option remains worth keeping.
As the primary price comparison tracker it is the variant worth keeping, though four years without visible traction raise doubts about its value.
E duplicates C, has shown no visible results since 2018, and like D before it should be pruned so maintenance effort can go to core business and new development.
The reporting extension complements A and the firm's analytics offer at little cost, so it is kept for now despite weak visibility.
